query: one category from an explicit vocabulary of spatially bounded indoor objects; per-frame positives mean some instance of that exact category is present. Do not turn scene target ids into input or claim instance discrimination.
method: Require archived full RGB, depth, real pose. Unique scene+native teacher route, unique trace, sample every fourth policy decision starting step1. Only wholly in-frame object box with 4px margin, min box width/height 16px, area>=400px, center ray + at least 12/25 rays hitting its OBB agree with actual rendered depth +/-0.10m and >=75% of all rays intersecting the OBB agree. Exclude low-quality RGB. A category negative is certified only if every labeled instance of that class is entirely outside the frustum by 4 pixels. No negative for classes absent from a scene catalog to reduce scene shortcuts. Observe actual first transitions between eligible sampled states. No claim of completeness or instance semantics from coordinates alone.
audit: Before fitting, sort all unique positive instances per scene by stable SHA of scene+id. Select first 10 per scene. For each choose the median bounding-box-area positive frame across routes, sort by class/id. Manual review both full image and box. Unclear or part-only results count as failed. Permit cheap fit only if training has >=12 distinct visually supported positive instances across >=6 categories, and >=70% positive QA precision across all 30 reviewed unique instances. Need >=2 independent development categories with reliable benchmark positives; report prior 5 annotated frames and mirrors independently, not independent-scene paths. Annotations used only offline. Fixed inference baseline DINO or full RGB CLIP with no projected boxes/pose; if no well-supported training data, release candidate manifest and stop fitting.
